sara (People Ops): Quick heads-up — the NYC office will be partially closed next Tue/Wed (May 12-13) for HVAC upgrades. A few notes below, please read if you plan to be onsite.

devon: Ugh timing. Which floors are affected?

sara (People Ops): Floors 4–6 will be inaccessible while crews are working. Lobby, conference rooms on 2/3, and kitchen remain open.

max: Will badge readers still work for people who normally sit on 5?

facilities-team: Badge access will be disabled for 4–6 between 8am–6pm both days. If you need gear from your desk, come by Mon after 4pm or we can coordinate a pickup.

julia: I have an onsite interview panel on Tue — should I reschedule?

sara (People Ops): If you can shift to remote for that day that's preferred. We can also move your panel to Conf A on 3rd floor (still available). Tell me and I’ll update the calendar invites.

devon: Travel question — I had flights booked to arrive Tue morning. Do we reimburse change fees?

ops-bot: Policy reminder: see https://intranet/redwood/travel-policy for exceptions.

sara (People Ops): Short answer: yes, change fees for company-directed changes are covered. If you change voluntarily (choose to travel despite closure) standard travel rules apply. Submit receipts via Concur and tag expenses with `nyc-hvac-2026`.

max: Is there alternate seating if I'm on 5 and can't access my desk? Hot desk options?

sara (People Ops): We’ll set up a temporary hot-desk cluster on 2nd floor (8 seats) first-come. If you need longer-term space for both days, ping me and I’ll reserve a conference room for you.

sara (People Ops): Shuttle option for people who normally park in the lot — building access might change, so we’re running a courtesy shuttle to nearby parking (Lot C) from 7:30–9:30 and 4:30–6:30. Schedule below: 
```
Lot C -> Building (morning): 7:30, 8:00, 8:30, 9:00
Building -> Lot C (evening): 16:30, 17:00, 17:30, 18:00
```

devon: Nice. Will there be signage?

facilities-team: Yes, we'll have directional signs at the building entrance and staff at the shuttle pickup.

julia: Any impact on deliveries or mail?

facilities-team: Couriers can still access the mailroom on 2. Larger shipments may be delayed — we'll notify recipients.

max: Coffee situation? :coffee:

sara (People Ops): Coffee station on 2 will be refilled; mobile espresso cart on Tue morning near the lobby (free). :tada:

devon: If I'm traveling but decide to stay remote instead, who do I tell?

sara (People Ops): Drop me a DM or reply here. Also update your calendar and OOO if needed.

ops-bot: Reminder: submit any expense reimbursements within 30 days.

sara (People Ops): Thanks everyone — sorry for the inconvenience. If you need anything special (equipment access, interview room, long-term desk), reply here or DM me directly. I’ll post a final confirmation on Fri with any last-minute changes. :white_check_mark:
